text: これで　こんどこそ　ほんとうに　ほんとうに　ものすごくて　すてきで　かんぺきな　ポケモンずかんを　かんせい　させるのじゃーッ！

structure.jp: これで　こんどこそ
structure.en: with this, this time for sure

structure.jp: ほんとうに　ほんとうに　ものすごくて　すてきで　かんぺきな　ポケモンずかんを
structure.en: a really, really tremendous, wonderful and perfect Pokémon encyclopedia

structure.jp: かんせい　させるのじゃーッ！

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: ものすごくて　すてきで
patterns.explanation: Describing words are strung together with くて or で, which work like 'and'. ものすごくて　すてきで = 'tremendous and wonderful and'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる means making something happen. かんせい　させる = 'make it complete', so 'complete it'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end can be a firm 'we will do it!'. のじゃー is the old-man form, shouted. させるのじゃー = 'we WILL complete it!'
